title: 『カレーにチョコを入れても隠し味』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, in a room lined with trophies, a certain racer is consulting a doctor about her condition.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Miss Ardan, it's too dangerous to increase your training any more than you are doing now. If you push yourself too far, your legs will—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't care what happens to my legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've always known that my time would be limited. But I will neither accept nor begrudge my fate. Instead…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But even if I'm just average, that doesn't mean I'm going to give up on my dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to defy it with these glass legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm unable to obtain even a single trophy to rival those that gleam on these shelves, I don't want to remain in my sister's shadow. I want to be me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't want to give up on myself… on the person I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: There she is! The young lady of the Mejiro family is here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ardan! Is it true that you've set your sights on the Classic Triple Crown? That you'll be entering the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes. That's what I'm planning.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you won't be competing in the Tiara tour like your sister, Mejiro Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That's too bad! Your fans were looking forward to seeing you compete in the Oka Sho and Japanese Oaks, like Ramonu before you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they were… But it is because my sister's achievements were so radiant that I have decided to aim elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That is why I, Mejiro Ardan, shall do everything I can to shine at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if the light I cast is no larger than a pinprick, that's enough. Unlike my sister, my legs are weak, but they're the only ones I have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: When I win, I do not want to be seen as a sister or cousin of another famous racer. I want to leave my mark as myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This is how I will fight my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That same day, atop the still-snowy mountaintops, a certain Umamusume battles against nature itself in an attempt to conquer her own struggles.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: You're so annoying! Just shut up, shrimp!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Waaaaah! Dad, Yaeno's being mean!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Hmph. It's not my fault you're a weakling.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, you are the weak one. Using violence to control others is a sign of weakness.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who—

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: That's why as the head of the Kongo Yaegaki style…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: I will take you, my granddaughter, under my wing. Now, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As a child, I was constantly angry. I used my fists to try to relieve that rage, but it never worked. It felt like I was burning on the inside.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I isolated myself from others, and I knew my parents were concerned about my future. But still…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grampa, you were the one who showed me the way.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was so close to stepping off the right path, but you patiently set me back on it. You helped settle my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Every time I tried to thank you, you would merely smile and say, "Your growth is the best thanks I care to receive."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's why I've decided to take on the Classic Triple Crown and engage in the fierce battle that determines the greatest Umamusume of all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's where I will face the challenge to which all racers aspire—the Derby. By defeating my rivals there…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to repay my gratitude toward you by showing you how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm working in my office, an unexpected Umamusume walks through the door.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, but I have come to inform you of something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but I must decline any invitations to partner run with Chiyono O for the foreseeable future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …At least until the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, as shocking as that was to hear…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I would prefer to avoid engaging in partner runs with Chiyono O for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki had stopped by earlier to tell me the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Both of them said that? But why?
choice_data_list: Because they don't want to lose to you.
Because they don't want to lose to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them probably know that Sakura Chiyono O is planning on racing in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why they want to avoid showing their hands too early—to treat her as a rival rather than a friendly training partner. After all…
choice_data_list: They want to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The Derby…
choice_data_list: What about you? What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I don't want to lose! After all, the Derby…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To me, the Derby is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: An incredibly special dream passed on to me, an ordinary racer, by an incredibly special person.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-of course, I know I'm not the only one to think highly of the Derby. You only get one shot at this race, so we all want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But that just makes the dream Maruzen entrusted to me all the more special.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Winning the Derby isn't a dream you bestow on just anyone. That race isn't a goal you can speak of lightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen's speed was incredible. I'm sure she would've won the Derby if she'd been able to enter it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But she had to give up on competing in it. I don't know why she had to do that, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Since she gave everything to me, I have no choice but to meet her expectations by claiming victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've looked up to Maruzen for so long, and I'm going use my victory to prove to her…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That if she had run in the Derby, she would have won too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, the lights in the gym are on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O stops in the middle of training to look at the training gym.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you think Yaeno and Ardan are still in there, training?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I thought being rivals in the Classics would be a bit more fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That there wouldn't be any hard feelings once we headed into the gates and ran that once-in-a-lifetime race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I thought everyone would praise and congratulate the winner, just like they did in the races I watched on TV as a kid.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I lose, I think I'll completely break down in tears.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to sincerely applaud for the winner or praise her eloquently either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because that's how hard I'm holding on to this wish… and how badly I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can't possibly lose this race, not when Maruzen was the one who entrusted her dream to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's declaration echoes with more strength than I've ever heard her speak with before.
